text.tspan: GRUCell / explicit reset-update gates | Operators & tensor flow
One step / I=H=16 / reset after recurrent affine / supplied parameters / read bottom to top
B=batch; x,h:[B,16]; affine tensors:[B,48]; chunks ordered r,z,n.
Reset multiplies h_n after its matrix multiplication and bias.
The function returns one hy tensor; parameters arrive from its caller.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.

节点 gru.x Current input x
节点 gru.h Previous hidden h
节点 gru.params Caller weights / biases
节点 gru.output Next hidden hy / one tensor
节点 gru.gi Input affine: x W_ih^T + b_ih
节点 gru.gh Hidden affine: h W_hh^T + b_hh
节点 gru.ci Chunk input affine / r,z,n
节点 gru.ch Chunk hidden affine / r,z,n
节点 gru.r_add i_r + h_r
节点 gru.r Sigmoid reset gate
节点 gru.z_add i_i + h_i
节点 gru.z Sigmoid update gate
节点 gru.rhn r * h_n / bias already included
节点 gru.n_add i_n + r * h_n
节点 gru.n Tanh candidate
节点 gru.delta h_previous - n
节点 gru.zdelta z * (h_previous - n)
节点 gru.hy n + z * (h_previous - n)
